name: Plans, Stripe billing, and usage

requirements.text: The active workspace entitlement enforces links, folders, direct QR campaigns, bio pages, domains, pixels, members, webhooks, link pages, active API keys, and retained media bytes.
Each workspace has one active local entitlement; new workspaces default to Free and existing owner plans are backfilled to workspace subscriptions.
Workspace billing shows the active workspace plan and usage for short links, domains, pixels, link pages, and webhooks.
Workspace metered creation rejects before exceeding a non-null plan limit while preserving existing data after downgrade.
Platform administrators assign plan overrides to a user's personal workspace; workspace owners may select Free for their current workspace.

Checkout, payment methods, cancellation/resume, invoices, and provider webhooks use Laravel Cashier with Stripe and never infer success from return query parameters; live provider verification requires test-mode credentials.
Usage invoices, proration, coupons, annual billing, and dunning use the Stripe Billing Portal flows; live verification requires merchant policy and credentials.

Effective workspace plans resolve a current unrevoked override, a valid Cashier subscription mapped by monthly/yearly price, then Free; unmapped provider prices fail closed and record an admin-visible health item.

The Phase 8 catalog fixes Free $0/$0, Pro $29/$290, and Business $99/$990 with 25/500/unlimited links, 5/100/unlimited folders, 5/250/unlimited QR campaigns, 1/10/unlimited bio pages, 0/3/unlimited domains, 0/10/unlimited pixels, 1/5/unlimited members, 0/5/unlimited webhooks, 1/25/unlimited link pages, 0/5/unlimited API keys, and 100 MB/10 GB/unlimited storage.

externalPrerequisites: Stripe API credentials and webhook secret
Merchant tax, invoice, and compliance policy

acceptanceCriteria.text: Checkout requires a visible active plan with a configured price and never infers success from query parameters.
Quota checks share one workspace usage service, lock the workspace, and never delete existing data after downgrade.
Missing Stripe configuration disables external actions truthfully without simulating payment success.

observedBehaviors: The billing screen shows current-plan details and usage meters.
An upgrade action and resource limits are visible.

implementationEvidence.description: Workspace billing, workspace usage, metered resource boundaries, and the complete Laravel suite passed (218 tests, 10,891 assertions).
implementationEvidence.reference: docker exec linkpilot-parity-smoke php artisan test --no-ansi; tests/Feature/Billing/WorkspaceBillingTest.php; tests/Feature/Workspaces/WorkspaceUsageTest.php; tests/Feature/Domains/CustomDomainTest.php; tests/Feature/LinkPages/LinkPageTest.php; tests/Feature/Webhooks/WebhookDeliveryTest.php

implementationEvidence.description: At localhost:8101, the owner billing page showed current workspace Pro usage and a Free-only change action; the workspace-admin page stated that only owners can change plans and contained no plan-change controls.

Phase 8 core suites passed 40 tests and 354 assertions across exact catalog values, resolver precedence/expiry, trialing and grace-period mapping, unknown-price fail-closed health, per-metric quotas, retained-byte accounting, downgrade preservation, API-key and admin enforcement.

A populated probe database proved exact catalog expansion, non-Free legacy_manual override backfill, media-purpose and nullable-expiry backfill, unchanged account/resource counts and media expiries, PRAGMA integrity_check=ok, zero foreign-key violations, and rollback reconstruction of legacy entitlements without record loss.

Billing surface suites passed 34 tests and 453 assertions covering public pricing, missing-configuration disabled states, owner-only checkout, hidden/invalid plan and interval rejection, return-query spoofing, provider-state resolver behavior, portal eligibility, setup checklist, and redacted provider props.

Managed Chromium confirmed the billing page renders the effective plan, all eleven usage metrics, and the labelled Stripe setup checklist with no checkout buttons while unconfigured; the public pricing page renders the catalog at 1440x1000 with no overflow or page errors.
